fields.summary: Change 'Submit' button label to 'Continue' on onboarding step 3
fields.description:
As a new user, I want the button on step 3 to say 'Continue' instead of 'Submit' so that the flow feels less like filling out a tax form.

Acceptance criteria:
* Button label reads 'Continue'
* No other changes

comments.body: Design here. Shouldn't it be 'Next'? 'Continue' implies there was a pause.
Good callout. Let's align in a sync.
Any copy change in the signup flow requires Legal review. Expected turnaround: 2-3 weeks.
Can we A/B test Submit vs Continue vs Next?
At current traffic we'd need ~6 weeks per variant for significance.
Per today's sync: going with 'Proceed'.
'Proceed' tested poorly in 2023. People thought it was a medical form.
Jumping in from the exec side. I'd love for it to say "Let's go!" with the exclamation point. Energy matters.
Love it. Updated AC to "Let's go!"
The apostrophe breaks the i18n pipeline. Need a ticket for that.
Update from leadership offsite: we're reverting to 'Submit'. Thanks all for the great collaboration on this one. Closing!
Story points (13) added to Sprint 41 velocity.
